news.headline: 黃仁勳向員工承認違反公司行為準則；輝達仍面臨 SEC、FBI、司法部調查
news.headline_en: Nvidia's Huang said he violated code of conduct, source says
news.plain: 黃仁勳在全員會議上承認違反部分行為準則、犯了「嚴重錯誤」。他和輝達仍面臨 FBI、司法部、SEC 等多項調查，12/3 要出席參議院公開聽證會。輝達股價週二跌近 6%。
news.plain_en: At an all-hands meeting Huang admitted breaching parts of the code of conduct and making 'terrible mistakes.' He and Nvidia still face FBI, DOJ and SEC probes, and he testifies at a public Senate hearing on Dec 3. The stock fell nearly 6% Tuesday.
news.why_me: 你持有 81 股輝達，目前占總資產約 20.9%。治理與調查風險還沒解除，照規則不加碼；超過 20% 上限，考慮減碼回 15～18%。
news.why_me_en: You hold 81 NVIDIA shares, about 20.9% of your assets. Governance and probe risks remain, so don't add; it is above your 20% cap — consider trimming to 15–18%.

news.headline: 輝達反彈退燒，科技股回落；週三 PCE 物價與 GDP 是 Fed 12 月決策前最後關鍵數據
news.plain: 週二科技類股跌 2.8%、醫療類股漲 2.9%。週三晚上公布 10 月 PCE 物價和第三季 GDP，距離 Fed 下次利率決策只剩兩週。
news.plain_en: Tech fell 2.8% and healthcare rose 2.9% on Tuesday. October PCE inflation and Q3 GDP come out Wednesday, just two weeks before the Fed's next rate decision.
news.why_me: 今晚（台灣時間 21:30）的物價數據若偏高，Fed 可能不降息，股市可能再震盪。你的預備金門檻是標普 5,874，目前離很遠，不需動作；你的嬌生屬醫療股，昨天反而受惠。
news.why_me_en: If tonight's (21:30 Taiwan) inflation data runs hot, the Fed may hold off on cuts and stocks could swing again. Your reserve trigger is S&P 5,874 — far away, no action. Your J&J is a healthcare stock, which benefited Tuesday.

news.headline: 台股狂飆 3,310 點，外資卻續賣 503 億、三大法人賣超 1,230 億
news.headline_en: Taiwan stocks soar 3,310 points, yet foreign investors keep selling NT$50.4B
news.plain: 加權指數大漲近 9% 收 40,122 點，是史上最大漲點；但外資和自營商大賣，成交金額僅 4,194 億元、是今年最低。
news.plain_en: TAIEX jumped nearly 9% to 40,122, its biggest point gain ever; but foreign investors and dealers sold heavily, and turnover of NT$419.4B was the year's lowest.
news.why_me: 你的台積電、0050、00881 都大漲。量少、外資還在賣，代表反彈不一定能持續；照計畫不追高、不增加科技曝險。
news.why_me_en: Your TSMC, 0050 and 00881 all jumped. Thin volume and continued foreign selling mean the rebound may not last; per your plan, don't chase or add tech exposure.

valuation.name: Google
valuation.note: 採用預估本益比、P/B、殖利率三法；PEG 因 EPS 含投資收益、成長率被灌水而排除。Morningstar 450 只當樂觀參考。
valuation.note_en: Uses forward P/E, P/B and dividend-yield methods; PEG excluded because investment gains inflate EPS growth. Morningstar $450 is an optimistic reference only.

valuation.name: 輝達
valuation.note: 5 年平均本益比 32 倍含 AI 泡沫期，不採用；殖利率法（股息太少）與 PEG（試算表公式誤植，且 95% 成長不可持續）也排除。改用預估 EPS × 15～20 倍（S&P 500 約 18 倍），並以 P/B 286 交叉驗證。
valuation.note_en: The 32x five-year average P/E reflects bubble years, so it is not used; the yield method (tiny dividend) and PEG (sheet formula error, 95% growth unsustainable) are excluded too. Uses forward EPS × 15–20x (S&P 500 is about 18x), cross-checked with P/B 286.

valuation.name: 嬌生
valuation.price_date: US close Mon 11/23/2026, Taiwan close Mon 11/23
valuation.note: 四種方法都在 165～210 之間，結論一致：現價明顯偏貴。PEG 98 偏低（成長率被專利到期拉低）不採用。
valuation.note_en: All four methods land between 165 and 210, a consistent verdict: the current price is clearly expensive. PEG (98) is excluded as patent expiries depress growth.

valuation.name: 博通
valuation.note: 預估本益比與 PEG 都在 390 上下；P/B 受 VMware 併購影響偏低，只當下限參考；殖利率法股息太少不採用。
valuation.note_en: Forward P/E and PEG both land near 390; P/B is depressed by the VMware deal and serves only as a floor; the yield method is excluded (dividend too small).

valuation.name: 高通

valuation.note_en: Forward P/E, yield and PEG all land between 128 and 143; P/B is distorted by heavy buybacks and excluded.
